TOOLING BURST BL-1a-r1 (re-fire of BL-1a, whose first run was killed by the host mid-burst; the tree is at the pre-burst state) — Blackwater lane round 1: landing clamped to walkable ground · rank-1 numbers per the references · lick flicker · tick response (Run C-5, BLACKWATER LANE; Matt 2026-09-16 pivot ruling — the fire DONE list applied to Blackwater next; conductor R-C5-106, defect F-C5-35). task_id "BL-1a-r1".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4b, T4f, T4s (all clauses), T4s-r2, T4s-r3, FL-2c and the new row "BL-1a — Blackwater round 1 (walkable landing · rank-1 numbers · lick flicker · tick response)" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-5/specs/blackwater_cocktail.json (RE-AUTHORED by the conductor from the Legolas audit — LAW; every number carries provenance; the tick schedule stays irregular pending Matt F4), export/godot_import.py (G2 component: g2_thrown_field, landing point resolution, ticks/victim_tint/contact_label, the painted pool binding, scorch decal), export/effect_kit.py (G2 validation), export/parallax_scene.py (walkable.json → collision_polygons: the walkable union + blocked polygons; the project also ships parallax/walkable.json with keys canvas_size/walkable/blocked/spawn/bounds), runs/C-5/cliffside_v38/ (staged real scene, READ ONLY), runs/C-5/conductor_scripts/probe_events.gd (KIT_CYCLES=11, FACE), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/blackwater_cocktail_e3/kit.json, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py, tests/test_effect_kit.py.
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

PART A — LANDING ON WALKABLE GROUND (F-C5-35; conductor, v38, 8 directions): the flask always lands at the full range along the facing — W lands the burning pool in the sky over the valley, SW/S on the void below the bridge. Rule: a G2 landing point must be WALKABLE. Implement: the exporter passes the walkable geometry (the walkable union from parallax/walkable.json, in world px) to the G2 component (a packed polygon array in the scene or config — your call, no raster); at release the landing point = the LAST walkable point along the throw line from the release socket out to range (sample every 8 px; Geometry2D.is_point_in_polygon over the walkable union minus blocked), never nearer than 1.0 BH from the release; the flight time scales with the shortened distance at the spec's speed (range/flight_s); the arc apex scales with distance (apex = d·tan(18°)/4). If the release point itself is not walkable (edge case), land at 1.0 BH along the facing. Trace clauses (probe_events, KIT_CYCLES=11, from (3760,640)): E → landing at range (walkable); W → landing on the clearing edge, x ≥ the walkable boundary, never over the valley; SW and S → landing on the bridge/clearing, not the void; all eight → the landing point passes is_point_in_polygon(walkable).

PART B — RANK-1 NUMBERS + LICK FLICKER (spec): re-bake blackwater_cocktail_e3 from the spec: field radius 181 px (2.78 BH dia), duration 2.5 s, flight 0.40 s at 520 px with apex 42 px (18° launch), scorch decal 12.0 s with fade-in 0.1 s and fade over the last 1.0 s (residue_diameter 3.2 BH), and a NEW presentation field `lick_flicker_hz [3.3, 3.6]` with `lick_coherence low`: the licks (P01 heads on the painted pool) flicker with a turbulent, low-coherence timescale ≈ 0.28–0.30 s — NOT synced to the damage ticks (two clocks: Legolas §4/§12.1); implement as per-lick seeded noise on scale/alpha with the characteristic period; validate the field (hz in [2,6], two values ascending). Trace clause: lick scale/alpha autocorrelation peak within 0.25–0.35 s; ticks unchanged.

PART C — TICK RESPONSE: the tick events already tint bodies inside the pool (conductor probe: two bodies per tick); record `body_index` on G2 contact/victim_tint events (currently null — instance ids only) and fire the contact label once per body per field (not per tick). Trace clause: an east cast from a position where the hound (VfxTarget_46) is inside the pool → victim_tint with body_index 5 on every tick; exactly one label for it.

PART D — byte locks re-opened by the emitted-scene change: re-baseline only with per-lock diff summaries (FL-1b rule); the catalogue lock stays red (E3-r1) — name it.

ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/BL-1a-r1/acceptance.json): Part A eight-direction landing table (point, walkable=true, distance, flight, apex); Part B kit fields + lick autocorrelation; Part C tick/body table; 16 kits byte-identical (blackwater_cocktail_e3: kit.json + any re-baked field PNG only; primitives untouched); full 17-kit catalogue export exit 0; headless import exit 0 (gl_compatibility); in-sandbox suite with the named tests green, remaining reds NAMED with the last traceback line.

Tests (unittest, stdlib): the landing clauses; the spec field validation; the tick body_index clause; extend only. DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/, export/replay.py, any kit except blackwater_cocktail_e3, anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/BL-1a-r1/; fixtures/ only for Part D. Do not run the Godot editor GUI. Do not deploy. Confine Godot logs to runs/C-5/t3/BL-1a-r1/.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "BL-1a-r1"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
